howto: Press Play. Look at the picture.
Tap the letters in order to spell it.
Spell without help for more stars.
tips: Tap the picture to hear the word.
The magnifier shows the next letter.
Tap a letter in a box to send it back.
Every word you spell goes into your book.

controls.keyboard: Type letters to place tiles, Backspace takes one back. P or Esc pauses.

difficulty: 15 levels from 3-letter to 9-letter words, each word has its own picture. The first six levels only accept the right letter.

features.age-or-level-bands: Five word-length levels on the title, with an age guide in the grown-ups report
features.hints: In-game Hint button places the next letter; the arcade Hint names the next letter or the wrong slot
features.grown-up-progress-report: Grown-ups button on the title: words tried and accuracy per level, practice days, the words missed most and a suggested next level
features.tutorial: Guided first word with coach cards (the timer waits); replay with Learn to play
features.results: Stars card with the words you spelled and new prizes
